title: N2 - a question and its negation should add to one
note: The docs warn that inverted phrasing is a trap for the reader of the code, but say nothing about whether the model answers the two phrasings consistently. If p(positive) + p(negative) drifts far from 1, the value depends on how the question was worded and not only on the state, which would mean every question in a codebase has to be audited for phrasing.
